_about: Public-domain John M. Krebs, Presbyterian minister of the Rutgers-Street Church, New York, for the Word Hoard: The Leader Fallen, The Private, Domestic and Social Life of Jesus Christ, The American Citizen, a discourse on the death of Zachary Taylor, and addresses on education and on physicians and clergymen. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 121 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

krebs-leader-fallen: The leader fallen : a sermon preached in the Rutgers-Street Church, New-York, on Sabbath morning, April 11th, 1841, on occasion of the death of William Henry Harrison, President of the United States of America (New-York : Harper & Bros., 1841)
krebs-physicians: The Reciprocal Relations of Physicians and Clergymen: A Speech, Delivered at (Henry Ludwig, 1847)
